name: Runmarö
description: Moderate 18.5 km clockwise island loop from Styrsvik, mixing village lanes, gravel road, forest paths, pasture edges, inland lakes and rugged eastern/central sections. Gatan and Långvik can work as alternate ferry access only when the timetable serves them. Plan for a full island day with limited public water, seasonal services and ferry-dependent logistics.
utilities: No confirmed public drinking-water point on the route.
Runmarö Lanthandel/Tempo is the strongest resupply point near Styrsvik, with self-scanning/customer caveats and hours to verify.
Svängen, Låttas bageri, Solberga Gård and Runmarö rum are seasonal/customer/booking services, not public utilities.

Do not show the Norrviken/Storön dry toilet as route-side: it is a real off-route harbor-context toilet with no drinking water, and it should not be conflated with the SAT-described Runmarö Varv/Solberga toilet candidate.
Hold the Runmarö Varv/Solberga toilet as a separate unpinned candidate; do not expose the SAT-published 2025 code.
No public drinking-water point should be rendered in iterations 1-5.
Styrsvik waiting shelter is transit comfort only, not a sleeping shelter.
waterSources: No app-facing public water source is confirmed in iterations 1-5.
SAT recommends carrying at least 2 liters and not using private water sources.
Norrviken/Runmarö Varv toilet is tagged drinking_water=no in OSM.
notes: Route shape: clockwise island loop from Styrsvik, with alternate ferry access at Gatan and Långvik when timetables serve them.
Use Swedish display names with diacritics, but keep ASCII IDs.
Runmarö is one of Stockholm County's floristically richest areas, especially its lime-influenced eastern habitats and wetlands.
All orchids are protected in Sweden; do not pick or disturb them.
Purren wetland is sensitive nature context and in the national mire protection plan, but no on-route visitor reserve page was found in iteration 1.
Iteration 2 geometry QA found no Runmarö-specific official route-change notice; official SAT route-change notices found were for other sections such as Ingmarsö and Sandhamn.

Iteration 4 third-party review checks suggest the route can feel easier than Moderate in dry/good conditions, but length, ferry logistics, limited water and rocky/rooty sections still justify the official Moderate difficulty.
Most land on Runmarö is privately owned and settlements are concentrated on the west/south side; avoid encouraging camping, water use or toilet use near private houses, docks, gardens or pastures.
Do not promote Båtsmanstorp nr 95 as a navigable POI because it is private property.
Do not import nearby Skötkobbarna, Nämdöskärgården national park, Telegrafberget nature reserve in Tyresö or Runnö nature reserve in Kalmar into this Runmarö walking section.

facilities.name: Runmarö Lanthandel / Tempo
facilities.description: Main grocery/resupply node near Styrsvik, with package/Systembolaget/OTC-related functions and app/self-scanning caveats. Do not render as a pharmacy or medical facility; operator page says pharmacy-agent service is temporarily gone.

facilities.name: Svängen Runmarö
facilities.description: Restaurant near the end of the SAT route. Customer restroom only; do not expose as a public toilet.

facilities.name: Solberga Gård farm shop / garden café
facilities.description: Farm shop confirmed by operator; garden café is mentioned by visitor/SAT sources but hours are not confirmed.

facilities.name: Silverträsket
facilities.description: Quiet inland lake and forest/wetland route anchor. Keep visitors on paths because Runmarö has sensitive lime-influenced flora.

facilities.name: Uppeby / Runmarö hembygdsgård and chapel
facilities.description: Central heritage cluster: local heritage center, Skärgårdsmuseet branch and nearby chapel.
